# SHARE SALE AND PURCHASE AGREEMENT

**Dated 28 April 2026**

**BETWEEN**

(1) **TAN WEI MING** (NRIC S79xxxxxA), of 12 Jalan Kembangan, Singapore 419xxx (the "**Seller**"); and

(2) **HARBOURVIEW VENTURES PTE LTD** (UEN 201912345K), a company incorporated in Singapore with its registered office at 80 Robinson Road #10-01, Singapore 068898 (the "**Buyer**").

## RECITALS

A. Kestrel Logistics Pte Ltd (UEN 201506789C) (the "**Company**") has an issued share capital of 1,000,000 ordinary shares.
B. The Seller is the legal and beneficial owner of 350,000 ordinary shares in the Company, representing 35% of the issued share capital (the "**Sale Shares**").
C. The Seller has agreed to sell and the Buyer has agreed to purchase the Sale Shares on the terms of this Agreement.

## 1. SALE AND PURCHASE
1.1 The Seller shall sell and the Buyer shall purchase the Sale Shares free from all encumbrances with effect from Completion.

## 2. CONSIDERATION
2.1 The total consideration for the Sale Shares is **Singapore Dollars Two Million Seven Hundred and Fifty Thousand (S$2,750,000.00)** (the "**Consideration**").
2.2 The Consideration shall be paid by the Buyer to the Seller in two tranches by telegraphic transfer to the Seller's nominated account at Straits Mercantile Bank Limited:
  (a) **Tranche 1**: S$420,000.00 within five (5) Business Days after Completion; and
  (b) **Tranche 2**: S$2,330,000.00 upon satisfaction of the Earn-out Condition in Schedule 2, and in any event no later than 31 December 2027.

## 3. COMPLETION
3.1 Completion shall take place on **15 May 2026** at the offices of the Buyer's solicitors.
3.2 At Completion the Seller shall deliver duly executed share transfer forms and the share certificates for the Sale Shares.

## 4. WARRANTIES
4.1 The Seller warrants that it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement and that the Sale Shares are fully paid.

## 5. GOVERNING LAW
5.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Singapore.

**SCHEDULE 2 — Earn-out Condition**
The Company's audited revenue for the financial year ending 31 December 2026 shall not be less than S$18,000,000.

---

**SIGNED** by TAN WEI MING
_/s/ Tan Wei Ming_
in the presence of: Priya Nair, Advocate & Solicitor

**SIGNED** for and on behalf of HARBOURVIEW VENTURES PTE LTD
_/s/ Daniel Koh_, Director
in the presence of: Priya Nair, Advocate & Solicitor

# THE ROSEWOOD FAMILY TRUST

## PART A — EXTRACT OF DEED OF SETTLEMENT

**This Deed of Settlement** is made on **9 March 2018** between:

**CHUA BENG HUAT** of Singapore (the "**Settlor**"); and
**MERIDIAN FIDUCIARY SERVICES (JERSEY) LIMITED**, registered in Jersey, Channel Islands, no. 98765 (the "**Trustee**").

1. **Establishment.** The Settlor hereby settles upon the Trustee the sum of **United States Dollars Five Million (USD 5,000,000)** (the "**Initial Trust Fund**") to be held on the trusts set out herein. The Trust shall be known as The Rosewood Family Trust.
2. **Beneficiaries.** The Beneficiaries are the Settlor's children, namely **CHUA MEI XIN** and **CHUA WEI JIE**, and their issue.
3. **Discretionary powers.** The Trustee may in its absolute discretion pay or apply the income or capital of the Trust Fund to or for the benefit of any one or more of the Beneficiaries.
4. **Proper law.** This Trust is governed by the laws of Jersey.

Signed by the Settlor: _/s/ Chua Beng Huat_
Signed for the Trustee: _/s/ A. Le Marchand_, Director

## PART B — LETTER OF DISTRIBUTION

**Meridian Fiduciary Services (Jersey) Limited**
Oak House, 22 Hill Street, St Helier, Jersey JE2 4UA

**10 March 2026**

To: Ms Chua Mei Xin
Re: The Rosewood Family Trust — Capital Distribution

Dear Ms Chua,

We refer to the resolution of the Trustee dated 2 March 2026. Following the passing of the Settlor, Mr Chua Beng Huat, on 14 November 2025, the Trustee has resolved to make a capital distribution to you as a Beneficiary of the Trust.

A distribution of **Singapore Dollars One Million Two Hundred Thousand (SGD 1,200,000.00)** was remitted on 10 March 2026 by telegraphic transfer to your account ending 7731 at Straits Mercantile Bank Limited, Singapore. The distribution was funded from the Trust's liquid assets, which derive from the Initial Trust Fund settled in 2018 and its investment returns.

The Trust Fund's net asset value as at 31 December 2025 was USD 7,420,000, per the Trust's accounts prepared by Lanes & Pryor LLP.

Yours faithfully,
_/s/ A. Le Marchand_
Director, for and on behalf of the Trustee
